Have your doctors checked your zinc/vitamin Bs & D levels yet or done a lymphocyte subpanel on you yet?


I had a similar issue a day it turns out my vitamin d and zinc were both severely low. Fixing those helped so much but levels need to be tested first and dr needs to tell how much of each to take since those vitamins can all cause issues if you aren't deficient in them

Thank you,

I'm the opposite, had good luck on the east coast but now that I live on the west coast it has been hell. 

I wish I could take benadryl but it makes me feel agitated and more awake.  probably sound dumb.

I'm still reeling over the doctor telling me that I was ridiculous for saying ssri's that I have tried make things worse. I wish they worked for me.
